scope: Initial, non-systematic source sample for designing testable research and evidence architecture.

source_records.title: Why Do Cancer Treatments Stop Working?
limitations: Cancer-focused overview; not a systematic review; does not establish a specific treatment for an individual.

source_records.title: Multilevel Mechanisms of Cancer Drug Resistance
limitations: Review conclusions depend on included studies; mechanisms require disease- and treatment-specific appraisal.

source_records.title: Chemoresistance and the tumor microenvironment: the critical role of cell–cell communication
limitations: Mechanistic review; does not establish clinical effectiveness of a proposed intervention.

source_records.title: Access to and accessibility of care for rural veterans with disabilities: a qualitative evaluation of VA healthcare experiences
limitations: Identifies experienced barriers; not a population prevalence estimate.

source_records.title: It's Like Finding Your Way Through the Labyrinth: A Qualitative Study of Veterans' Experiences Accessing Healthcare
limitations: Context-specific participant accounts; not a representative prevalence estimate.

source_records.title: A rapid review of the barriers and facilitators of mental health service access among Veterans and their families
limitations: Mental-health access scope; transfer to other benefits/services needs justification.

source_records.title: Administrative burden for patients in U.S. health care settings Post-Affordable Care Act: A scoping review
limitations: General U.S. healthcare context, not solely veteran services; not an intervention-effect estimate.

source_records.title: Principles of Evidence Synthesis Research
limitations: Guidance does not prove a particular project complies.

source_records.title: The FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship
limitations: FAIR is not equivalent to truth, validity, ethical access, or correct interpretation.

claims.proposition: In cancer treatment resistance, multiple mechanisms—including tumor heterogeneity, cellular adaptation, and interactions with the tumor microenvironment—can contribute together; a useful research map must preserve disease and treatment scope.
claims.confidence_rationale: Convergent sources support this bounded statement about cancer treatment resistance, not all diseases.
not_established: Clinical benefit from a proposed combination
claims.next_test: Choose one cancer, treatment class, and resistance phenotype; pre-register a mechanism-specific prediction, controls, readouts, and disconfirmation criteria.

claims.proposition: Qualitative studies and reviews report that navigation, communication, coordination, transportation, provider availability, paperwork, and administrative friction can shape veterans' access to care; the magnitude and distribution of each barrier require context-specific measurement.
claims.confidence_rationale: Relevant qualitative and review sources support reported failure modes, not a universal prevalence estimate.
not_established: That every veteran experiences these barriers
That a specific benefit is available to an individual
That a proposed interface will reduce the barriers
claims.next_test: Map one real service pathway using current official policy, timestamps, handoffs, user effort, drop-off, and outcome measures; compare with a defined baseline.

claims.proposition: Evidence synthesis guidance and FAIR principles support explicit methods, source metadata, qualified links, provenance, limitations, and uncertainty; these practices improve inspectability but do not automatically make a conclusion true.
claims.confidence_rationale: Grounded in established research-method guidance and data stewardship principles.
not_established: That a software implementation is compliant
claims.next_test: Validate claim records against schema; test broken links, missing provenance, unsupported promotion, conflict preservation, and revision trace.

claims.proposition: Whether a navigable, metaphor-rich evidence interface improves comprehension, error detection, agency, or task completion is an empirical design question.
claims.confidence_rationale: A design hypothesis proposed for direct testing; no outcome data are claimed.
claims.next_test: Run an accessible task study against a conventional source-list interface; measure accuracy, source recall, uncertainty calibration, time, corrections, and adverse confusion.
